{{Quote|Studying cartography has been my dream, ever since my uncle showed his great heroism as a pilot for the Rebel Alliance. But&hellip;they don't like me here. Everyone is afraid of me, and the run away if they see me coming. No one wants to talk to me. Even my professors! Our people have been so private for so long that others react only to my appearance, and refuse to look beyond it. To them, I seem a constant threat.|The child|<ref name="EGTAS" />}}
[[Tagg Sivrak|Tagg]] and [[Nira Sivrak]] had a '''child''' who attended the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]] studying [[Cartographer/Legends|cartography]]. Their uncle was [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]], who was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. However, the child's experience at the University of Coruscant was not a positive one, as the reputation that the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanens]] had in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and their appearance cause the other students to regard them with fear.<ref name="EGTAS" />
